title: JuryDAO
tagline: A DAO-driven security system for online gaming that uses blockchain technology to promote fairness and discourage cheating.
description: JuryDAO is a DAO-driven security system that aims to create a secure and fair online gaming environment by utilizing blockchain technology. It employs a consensus-based approach where jurors, who are selected from the community, review and vote on reported cases of cheating or unfair behavior in online games. The DAO's smart contracts handle part of the dispute resolution process, and the outcome is enforced on the blockchain, making it transparent and tamper-proof. By leveraging the power of blockchain, JuryDAO aims to discourage cheating, promote fairness, and improve the overall gaming experience for players.
how_its_made: JuryDAO is built using cutting-edge technologies, leveraging decentralized protocols and smart contracts on the EVM blockchain. It utilizes user participation and token collateral to create a transparent and accountable dispute resolution process. The system encourages fair play and discourages cheating in online games by holding users financially responsible for their actions.
